Fuel Bottle.label: Reported fuel bottle composition
Fuel Bottle.note: The bottle composition can differ from the diluted test fuel.

Fuel MFC.label: Fuel MFC maximum capacity
Fuel MFC.note: Controller full-scale capacity on a nitrogen calibration basis; not the flow rate during a flame.

N2 MFC.label: Nitrogen MFC maximum capacity
N2 MFC.note: Controller full-scale capacity on a nitrogen calibration basis; not the flow rate during a flame.

Fuel conc. Range.label: Daily fuel-concentration schedule
Fuel conc. Range.note: Fuel volume fraction after nitrogen dilution, varied between and sometimes during flames. Extinction can occur before the lowest listed concentration is reached; this is not an oxygen concentration or measured extinction limit.
